name: Miguel Calero
headline: Customer Experience Leader & Business Development Expert | Helping Build Great Businesses and a Positive Impact
about:
Results and people-oriented Customer Experience leader with over 12 years of experience in the BPO industry. Focused on team development, strategic planning, Lean process improvement, project management, managing Key Client Relations, and driving business growth. 

Extensive experience leading multifunctional and multicultural teams across different GEOs with a proven track record for building and growing customer care organizations. I value collaboration, diversity, and continuous learning, and I seek to bring these qualities to my team and my clients.

• Direct management of a staff of Account Managers, Training/Quality Managers, Operation Managers, supervisors, and over 200 call center agents remotely across different GEOs.

• Responsible for the overall day-to-day performance of all three centers including implementation and onboarding of new clients, forecasting staffing, training, and quality.

• Manage key client Relations for the company, including new implementations and business development. 

• Project Manager in all areas of the business, including business development, marketing, customer experience, sales, and operations. 

• Report directly to the CEO, implementing set agendas, and achieving tactical/strategic company goals.
